title: GranularityValue
description: Value posted onto the Granularity panel (engine-owned, GSM-spine): consolidation verdict per Definition. Distinct from Definition.Merge: Granularity runs AFTER Statement shaping, so its mergeWith verdict is informed by the populated GSM statement and takes precedence over any earlier identity-time Definition.Merge for the same identity (Override Cascader supersedes the earlier Merge).
